parent_evidence.rain72: 72 h antecedent precipitation amount predicts strong 0->CI2/3 activation after DaysSinceRain adjustment.
parent_evidence.instantaneous_air_moisture: Survey-midpoint VPD and RH do not explain the strong-activation signal once rain72 is included.
parent_evidence.current_light_rain: Survey-time categorical light rain does not explain the strong-activation signal.
parent_evidence.local_template: Strong chorus reactivation is concentrated in previously used species x SiteID combinations.

question: Does shallow soil wetness at the survey time account for the accumulated-rainfall signal, or does antecedent precipitation retain an association beyond surface soil moisture?
sample: Same NAAMP matched pairs used by the hydric-cue analysis, requiring both runs to have parseable survey midpoint, route-centroid coordinates, ERA5 72 h precipitation and ERA5 volumetric soil water at the survey midpoint.

weather_source.rain72: tp hourly accumulation over the 72 h ending at the survey-midpoint hour
weather_source.soil_layer1: swvl1 / GRIB paramId 39, volumetric soil water layer 1, m3 m-3
weather_source.soil_layer2: swvl2 / GRIB paramId 40, volumetric soil water layer 2, m3 m-3; secondary
weather_source.spatial_link: nearest ERA5 0.25 degree grid cell to route centroid
weather_source.temporal_link: nearest exact hourly timestamp to local survey midpoint converted to UTC

contrasts.soil1_gain: wet-run swvl1 minus dry-run swvl1; positive means wetter survey had wetter shallow soil
contrasts.soil2_gain: wet-run swvl2 minus dry-run swvl2; positive means wetter survey had wetter deeper soil
contrasts.rain72_amount: z-scored wet-minus-dry difference in log1p 72 h precipitation amount

primary_model: strong_new_score ~ rain_contrast + rain72_amount_difference_z + soil1_gain_difference_z + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber), route-clustered covariance.

primary_predictions.antecedent_rain_independent: rain72_amount_difference_z beta >0 with complete 95% CI >0 after soil1 adjustment.
primary_predictions.soil_mediated_pattern: soil1 supported while rain72 is not CI-positive.
primary_predictions.rain_beyond_soil_pattern: rain72 supported while soil1 is not CI-positive.

secondary: Use new_ci3_count as the full-chorus endpoint.
Repeat primary model in same-observer + physically stable pairs.
Report correlations among rain72, swvl1 gain and swvl2 gain.
minimum_gate: At least 3500 matched pairs and 500 routes; swvl1 identity, units and finite-range audit must pass.
interpretation: ERA5 soil water is a coarse route-scale environmental proxy, not frog body hydration or pond depth.
A swvl1 effect would support ground-moisture state but not prove physiological hydration mediation.
Persistence of rain72 after swvl1 would be consistent with rainfall-coupled processes not captured by shallow soil water, including breeding-site inundation, but would not prove them.
All exposures are observational; no causal mediation claim and no RC11 submission modification are authorized.
